about_the_game:
HELLBOUND INC

HELLBOUND INC is a puzzle platformer where you play as an undead courier trapped in a fulfillment center recently purchased by Satan himself.

You're the newest hire in Hell’s most infernal logistics startup. Your job? Deliver cursed packages across treacherous work zones, dodge deadly traps, solve infernal puzzles, and make sure everything arrives on time. In Hell, missing a delivery deadline is eternal damnation. Again.

YOU’RE UNDEAD, BUT NOT UNEMPLOYED

Navigate rooms filled with spikes, flame jets, demonic machinery, and collapsing platforms. Push crates, flip switches, activate conveyor belts, and time your jumps to get each delivery to its destination. Every area is a tightly designed challenge that tests both your reflexes and your problem-solving skills.

YOU WILL DIE. A LOT.

But that’s okay — you’re already un-dead. Instant respawns keep the pace fast as you retry and learn each delivery route. Every room has a solution... but it may not be the one you expect.

THIS IS YOUR AFTERLIFE NOW

As you dive deeper into the fulfillment center, you’ll encounter even more elaborate delivery puzzles, new environmental hazards, and increasingly absurd demonic logistics systems.

IN HELLBOUND INC DEMO YOU’LL FIND:

  • Initial area of the Game

  • 6 Tutorial Levels

  • 10 Regular levels

  • 3 bonus Levels

  • 5 Easter Eggs

  • Tons of Death

DELIVER OR BURN

There’s no rest for the dead. Clock in, grab your Package, and make the delivery — because Satan doesn’t do refunds.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra)
  • Processor: Dual Core 2 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
  • Additional Notes: Game runs on most low-end Mac systems.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple Silicon (Rosetta 2 supported)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD equivalent / Apple M1 or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster load times. Controller support included.
